key: Whismur is drawn to the PokéSnax in your bag!
en: Whismur is drawn to the PokéSnax in your bag!
ja: ゴニョニョが、バッグの中のポケスナックにひきつけられている!
ゴニョ! ゴニョゴニョ、ゴニョニョ!
空腹のポケモンが襲いかかってきた!

key: Good day. I am the owner of this lot.
en: Good day. I am the owner of this lot.
ja: ごきげんよう。わたしはこの土地の所有者です。

key: I'm looking for a tenant to rent this space to.
en: I'm looking for a tenant to rent this space to.
ja: この物件を貸す借り手を探しています。

key: If you find anyone in need of a place to stay, do refer them.
en: If you find anyone in need of a place to stay, do refer them.
ja: 住まいを必要としている方を見かけたら、ぜひご紹介ください。

key: This place is great, nice find, pal!
en: This place is great, nice find, pal!
ja: ここ、いいところだな。見つけてくれてありがとよ!

key: Not that I have any furniture to move in, but I'm sure I'll find a way home before long.
en: Not that I have any furniture to move in, but I'm sure I'll find a way home before long.
ja: 運び込む家具なんてないけどな、そのうち家に帰る方法も見つかるだろうさ。

key: Look, I really appreciate you helping me out here. I wanna give you something. Go ahead, take it. 'S a buddy of mine, but it'll be cool to you.
en: Look, I really appreciate you helping me out here. I wanna give you something. Go ahead, take it. 'S a buddy of mine, but it'll be cool to you.
ja: なあ、ここまで助けてくれて本当に感謝してるんだ。何か渡したいんだけど。ほら、受け取ってくれ。オレの相棒なんだが、お前にとってもきっといい奴だと思うぜ。

key: Take good care of it, all right? Yourself, too!
en: Take good care of it, all right? Yourself, too!
ja: ちゃんと大事にしてやってくれよ、いいな? お前自身もな!
